To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the energy density in the open string tachyonic mode vanishes asymptotially, that the dilaton field approaches a constant value, that the 9-form field strength decays exponentially and that the metric approaches the AdS vacuum.
(i) The open string energy density decays exponentially fast with a decay rate proportional to g s, (ii) The total energy of the system decays exponentially fast to zero.
The open string energy density vanishes asymptoticaly, independently how small g s is.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fate of the tachyon in the presence of closed string modes.
the fate of the tachyon energy density, and the fate of the D-brane.
the question of what happens to the open string energy when the tachyon rolls to its vacuum value.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the open string tachyonic instability is resolved in a consistent string background, and that no closed string singularity is produced.
the backreaction of the open string tachyons is such that they decay completely, and the final state is a closed string vacuum with no open string modes.
the open string tachyons decay completely, leaving a pure closed string state.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have computed the effective action for the rolling tachyonic field in the string frame, including all couplings to the metric and the dilaton.
we have shown that the backreaction to a decaying brane is not a problem in string theory.
, in the effective action approach, the backreaction of the closed strings is sufficient to explain the decay of the unstable D9 branes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the open string energy decays in a time scale that is much shorter than the time scale of the backreaction.
the effective action for the tachyon is a good starting point to compute the decay of the brane.

the open string tachyonic instability can be described as a decay of the D9 brane, and the final state is a configuration of closed string modes with a constant energy density, which is the same as the energy stored in the unstable D9 branes at the initial time.
